notes.title: Special Update for Seek Demo!
notes.content: This update will entirely replace the original Demo content! After the update, you will be able to experience a small portion of the full version, featuring a larger map, more types of monsters and weapons, as well as a brand-new mechanic that can alter the environment to some extent. The removed Demo content will likely not return... but you can still find some Easter eggs related to it in both this Demo and the full version
